newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich Re says tunnel fire costs low.
newsitem.headline: Munich Re says tunnel fire costs low.

text.p: German reinsurance giant Muenchener Rueckversicherung (Munich Re) said on Tuesday its costs related to last week's fire in the Channel Tunnel were expected to come out as "far less than 50 million marks ($32.8 million) ".
"On the basis of provisional calculations, the fire will cost us far less than 50 million marks, damage and lost earnings included," a spokesman said in response to enquiries.
He added that the estimate was based on the typical exposure that Munich Re, the world's largest re-insurance group, would have to risks of this nature.
The overall cost of damage caused by the fire has still not been established. Sources close to tunnel operator Eurotunnel Plc /SA have put the cost in the tens of millions of pounds.
